# OpenNava

> An open TV launcher for Android TV, Google TV and Fire TV with a companion phone app.

## For AI agents

- [Setup instructions](https://open-nava.com/agent/agent.md): install OpenNava on a person's own TV and add their media libraries.

## Links

- [Live demo](https://open-nava.com/)
- [Source and releases](https://github.com/fcore247/opennava)
